# API availability by profile

A feature the profile lacks fails to compile in a script, with a hint that names the fix (`RENSGA_REQUIRES_FEATURE`, api-rules.md section 6), and the cooker refuses a scene whose components need it. Windows, Linux and Android builds of a project keep the features of the project's profile, so a script behaves the same on the console and on the PC.

A project can override both tables in `ProjectSettings/ConsoleTarget.json` with `"features"` and `"limits"`.

## Features

| Feature | API | PSX | PSP | PS2 | If missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lighting` | Light, RenderSettings (ambient) | yes | yes | yes | bake light into vertex colors (DirectionalLight) |
| `skinning` | SkinnedMeshRenderer, Animation::Play/Stop | no | yes | yes | use sprite or vertex animation |
| `fog` | RenderSettings.fogEnabled/fogColor/fogStart/fogEnd | yes | yes | yes | fade to the background color in the art |
| `osk` | TouchScreenKeyboard::Open | no | yes | no | read the text from a UI field |
| `saveDialog` | Save::setMode(SaveMode::SystemDialog) | no | yes | no | keep Save::setMode(SaveMode::Auto) |
| `battery` | SystemInfo::batteryLevel, batteryStatus | no | yes | no | do not branch on battery |
| `cpuClock` | Application::SetCpuClock | no | yes | no | remove the call |
| `textureSwizzle` | (cooker) swizzled texture upload | no | yes | yes | none needed; the cooker picks linear textures |

## Limits

| Limit | PSX | PSP | PS2 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lights per object | 3 | 4 | 8 |
| Bones per draw (0 = not batched) | 0 | 8 | 0 |
| Skinned joints per skeleton (0 = none) | 0 | 64 | 64 |
| Largest texture edge (px) | 256 | 512 | 1024 |
| Device RAM limit (bytes, 0 = not checked) | 2097152 | 33554432 | 0 |

## What each feature covers

- `lighting`: Run-time lights on meshes with a material.
- `skinning`: Skeletal animation (PSX uses segmented rigid models).
- `fog`: Distance fog.
- `osk`: System on-screen keyboard.
- `saveDialog`: System save/load dialog.
- `battery`: Battery level and charging state.
- `cpuClock`: CPU clock control.
- `textureSwizzle`: Swizzled textures in VRAM.
